zh: 命令的先后顺序不影响最终位置，只需要知道最终相对起点的净位移。
把每个U记为+1、每个D记为−1，净位移的正负就决定了答案。
统计U的个数减去D的个数：大于0输出U，小于0输出D，等于0输出一个空行。
en: The order of the commands does not change the final position; only the net displacement from the start matters.
Count each U as +1 and each D as -1; the sign of the net displacement decides the answer.
Compute the number of U minus the number of D: print U if it is positive, D if it is negative, and an empty line if it is zero.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Count the net displacement of U and D.

## Proof of correctness

Each U contributes +1 and each D contributes -1; the sign of the net sum alone determines the final relative position.

## Complexity

Time O(n), space O(1).

## Source note

Based on the pinned OAMaster problem statement; this site separately defines the standard input/output protocol.
